errors.evidence: The x-axis label is "Bruttoarbeitseinkommen (in 1.000)". The unit "Euro" is not mentioned in the figure and is an assumption.

The description states there are six intervals on the x-axis, but there are clearly seven categories shown in the chart: "0 – < 20", "20 – < 40", "40 – < 60", "60 – < 80", "80 – < 100", "100 – < 200", and "≥ 200".

errors.evidence: The statement "Keine Balken sind ... beschriftet" (No bars are labeled) is factually incorrect, as the bars are clearly labeled with their values. The sentence then immediately contradicts itself, making the description confusing and poorly phrased.
